syllabus_extract: Lift augmentation. High lift devices. Boundary Layer control
specific_objectives: 11.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to describe various types of aerofoil sections, conditions of performance, theories, and concept related with performance

intro_questions: What is the primary function of high lift devices?
Define boundary layer control in the context of lift augmentation.

Identify one limitation of using high lift devices on a helicopter rotor.
